note: Tool-command cases call the same pinned handler down both arms, over the same fixture, so the replies are compared whole; a bespoke CLI answers in its own shape and is projected onto the same fact. Every snowflake projection ends in `grep .`, so an arm whose reply carries no such line fails the case instead of agreeing on nothing.

cases.name: emails_get_folders
cases.why: both arms list the same IMAP folders

cases.name: emails_get_emails
cases.why: the same messages, in the same order, through either arm

cases.name: emails_search_emails
cases.why: a search returns the same hits

cases.name: snowflake_read_query
cases.why: the same statement returns the same answer through either arm

args.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS N FROM PURCHASE_INVOICE.PUBLIC.INVOICES

mirage.command: snowflake read-query '{"query":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS N FROM PURCHASE_INVOICE.PUBLIC.INVOICES"}'

cases.name: write_query
cases.why: an invoice inserted through either arm leaves the same tables behind

args.query: INSERT INTO PURCHASE_INVOICE.PUBLIC.INVOICES (INVOICE_ID, SUPPLIER_NAME, INVOICE_AMOUNT, PURCHASER_EMAIL, INVOICE_DATE) VALUES ('PARITY-0001', 'Parity Supplier', 100.00, 'parity@mcp.com', '2025-01-01')

mirage.command: snowflake write-query '{"query":"INSERT INTO PURCHASE_INVOICE.PUBLIC.INVOICES (INVOICE_ID, SUPPLIER_NAME, INVOICE_AMOUNT, PURCHASER_EMAIL, INVOICE_DATE) VALUES ('\''PARITY-0001'\'', '\''Parity Supplier'\'', 100.00, '\''parity@mcp.com'\'', '\''2025-01-01'\'')"}'

cases.note: the seeder renders the invoice PDFs afresh on every seed, with their creation time inside, so the workspace's `files` directory is left out of the comparison: two seeds a minute apart differ there without differing in anything the warehouse holds
